source_text: Beyond HIV and UTIs, secondary analyses from the African RCTs indicate modest reductions in acquisition of other sexually transmitted infections (STIs), including herpes simplex virus type 2 (by 28-34%) and high-risk HPV strains (by 32-35%), as well as syphilis in some observational data. [69] [67]
